text:
marie (PM): Quick sync — we need to finalize DP selection criteria + success metrics for Q2 beta. I'm thinking we run a 6-week beta with 8–10 partners. Thoughts?
sofia (Design): 6-week sounds good. suggest 2-week onboarding + 4-week active usage window. Keep feedback cadence weekly.
vikram (Eng): Agree. Onboarding should include a small integration lab — 2 API keys + example infra. Need commit from partner engineers: ~4 hrs/week.
henry (CS): Important to pick partners with clear product metrics to avoid fuzzy signals. prefer customers with search/chat features and >50k monthly active users.
alexa (Growth): Incentives — credits + co-marketing? We can offer $10k in platform credits + a customer spotlight webinar.
marie (PM): Proposed screening checklist:
```criteria
- product fit: chat or semantic search
- usage signal: >= 50k MAU or >=100k tokens/mo
- privacy: willing to sign NDA + SOC2 ok
- engineering time: min 4 hrs/week during onboarding
- success sponsor: PM + Eng lead assigned
```
sofia (Design): Add willingness to share real prompts and evaluation labels. need at least 20 labeled examples per domain.
vikram (Eng): Also verify infra: can they accept streaming responses, or do they need polling? If polling, we need an adapter.
nora (Ops): Timeline constraints: Q2 calendar has 2 weeks runway for recruitment. Recruit window: 3/15–3/29, onboard 4/1–4/14, live 4/15–5/12.
henry (CS): Success metrics suggestion (quantitative):
- integration time <= 10 days
- weekly active sessions >= 1k after week 2
- latency P95 <= 500ms (for 90% of requests)
- qualitative: NPS >= +30 from partner engineering and PMs
alexa (Growth): Feedback loop: weekly survey + biweekly 45-min working session. use this short survey:
```survey
1) How useful was the model output? (1–5)
2) Did you observe regressions vs baseline? yes/no, details
3) Deployment blockers this week?
4) Suggestions for prompt/config changes
```
marie (PM): Launch gating (must-haves):
- 3 partners with positive trend on usage + no critical regressions
- runbook for rollback + fallback model in place
- documented onboarding guide + sample prompts
sofia (Design): Can we add a lightweight eval harness to surface quality regressions? weekly A/B vs baseline on 200 prompts.
vikram (Eng): Agree — I'll add a simple CI job that runs the 200-prompt eval and posts results to the console dashboard.
marie (PM): Decision items before recruitment: final incentive package, screening form, and legal NDA template. Owners?
alexa (Growth): I'll own incentives & outreach copy.
nora (Ops): I'll own screening form + coordinate with legal on NDA.
henry (CS): I'll coordinate onboarding checklist with eng docs.
marie (PM): Great. Quick action list:
- @alexa draft outreach copy by Fri 3/8
- @nora screening form + NDA by Mon 3/11
- @vikram eval harness + onboarding demo by Tue 3/12
- @sofia sample prompt set + UI feedback guide by Tue 3/12
Let's reconvene next Wed 3/13 10am PT — short sync.
alexa (Growth): noted :thumbsup:
dp-bot: Reminder set for 2025-03-13T17:00:00Z (10:00 PT)
marie (PM): Thanks everyone — going to start a Notion page and share links.
